'''Morton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], serving [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] within the [[Office of Peace and Security]], a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. He was a contact of the [[Thaereian military]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Drom Virbilge]] and in circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Virbilge contacted Morton, warning him that there was going to be some trouble at the house of [[Krol-Pek]], a male [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on Cularin. Virbilge also gave Morton a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] and told him to give it to the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who possessed a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] containing some information regarding three data transmitters that had been placed on Cularin by the [[Metatheran Cartel]]. Morton and a number of OPS [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] then made their way to Krol-Pek's house and captured a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that were attacking the building.
